text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden org QPS surge detected org=BlueRidgeAnalytics region=us-west — sustained 10m P95 > 1.2s, 502s trending up. Paging @oncall-sre and @eng-runtime :rotating_light:

alexa: dashboards confirm. Org error budget close to 5%, traffic ~6x normal baseline.

sam: traces show bulk of traffic from batched embeddings + many concurrent streaming chat sessions. Spike start ~2026-03-15T14:12Z.

devon: KV cache miss rate jumped, looks like prefix variety and some very long sequences.

eng-runtime: queues building on shared GPU pool for hosted customers. Long-tail sequence combos causing kernel stalls.

pranav: can we split BlueRidge into a separate pool temporarily or is that too slow?

eng-runtime: spinning up dedicated pool is safer but takes ~30-45m. Fastest immediate control is an org-level emergency rate cap.

oncall-sre: acknowledge. Ready to apply override. What QPS target? current observed ~320 qps, default per-org cap 200.

alexa: recommend 50 r/s with burst 200 for an initial 20min window, then reassess. Should reduce queueing without outright failing jobs.

cs-ops: BlueRidge runs production reports — need to notify them first, to avoid surprise errors.

sam: I'll notify support and draft a message with the mitigation.

oncall-sre: applying org override now. Runbook snippet:```bash
# temp org qps override
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/internal/api/orgs/override_rate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"org_id":"blue_ridge_analytics","qps":50,"burst":200,"ttl_seconds":1200}'
```

oncall-sre: API response: 200 OK {"status":"applied","org_id":"blue_ridge_analytics","qps":50} :white_check_mark:

alexa: additionally toggling streaming off for this org for 10m — rewriting streaming calls to non-streaming to avoid long-lived connections.

eng-runtime: pushed routing rule to rewrite streaming=true -> streaming=false for org blue_ridge_analytics. Config snippet:```
rule {
  match: {org: "blue_ridge_analytics", endpoint: "/v1/chat/stream"}
  action: {proxy_to: "/v1/chat", transform: {strip_stream: true}}
}
```

pranav: enabling prefix KV caching for common job patterns as a secondary mitigation — should reduce repeated compute for identical prefixes.

sam: sent customer note to BlueRidge support alias: "We're seeing an unexpected traffic surge causing elevated latency. We're applying a temporary per-org QPS limit and disabling streaming for 10 minutes while we stabilize. We'll share updates and can discuss a temporary quota increase if needed."

cs-ops: customer responded: "We're running critical nightly reports. If errors continue, can you provide a short-term quota bump?"

oncall-sre: monitoring metrics now. Queue depth decreasing and 5xxs dropping.

eng-runtime: observed P95 drop from ~1200ms to ~420ms within ~30s of override. 502s count declining. Token compute/sec down ~65%.

devon: logs indicate repeated replay-like jobs from a small set of API keys in IP range X.X.X.X hitting streaming endpoints every few seconds — likely a misconfigured job. Recommend per-key throttles.

alexa: agree. We'll keep org-level protection but add stricter per-key limits for offenders.

oncall-sre: applying key throttle:```http
POST /internal/api/keys/throttle
{"api_key":"br-prod-xyz","qps":10,"ttl_seconds":600}
```

oncall-sre: applied 200 OK.

eng-runtime: starting a canary route to move a fraction of new requests to our us-east warm pool (lower contention) — canary 10% then ramp to 50% if healthy.

pranav: do we want to proactively offer BlueRidge an emergency quota bump while they fix the replay job? Might be a business decision.

cs-ops: propose a one-time temporary quota increase conditional on stopping the offending job; I'll draft terms and notify billing.

sam: oncall-sre, please schedule a 15m handoff in 10 minutes with the next oncall. I'll join the handoff.

oncall-sre: scheduled. eng-runtime will maintain mitigations until 14:45Z then hand off.

incident-bot: ACTION_SUMMARY: {"org":"blue_ridge_analytics","applied_actions":["org_qps_override:50","disable_streaming:10m","key_throttle:br-prod-xyz:10qps","route_canary:us-east-warm:10%"]}

alexa: follow-ups: root cause investigation, post-incident review, onboarding guardrails to prevent replay storms, add detection rule for repeated short-interval streaming sessions.

pranav: add an alert for per-org token consumption > 3x baseline sustained 5m.

cs-ops: I'll send the formal customer update and set temporary quota terms.

sam: tl;dr for pager — emergency QPS cap & streaming disabled for BlueRidge; per-key throttles applied; latency improving; customer notified; follow-ups: RCA, postmortem, onboarding guardrails. Reopen thread if regressions occur. :thumbsup:
